card.name: Words just before a year in biographies
card.fires_on: Life-event words such as death, born, retirement or discovery right before a year in biographical text. Also fires on digits inside years and on 'back' in 'back in December'.

modes.label: Life event before a year
modes.description: A noun or verb for a life event comes just before the year it happened.
modes.example: Wordsworth was England's Poet Laureate from 1843 until his<< death>> in 1850.

modes.label: Digits inside a number
modes.description: A digit partway through a year or model number.
modes.example: In 19<<9>>8, George Jackson of UCLA's Department

modes.label: Back in a past month
modes.description: The word back used to place a past event in time.
modes.example: the FDA released<< back>> in December.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd tokens and away from forms of 'back', so no clear meaning beyond that.
card.plain: It lights up on words like death or retirement that come right before a year in a biography.
